task: Research the Python documentation for queue.Queue: explain why it is useful between threads, in two sentences with sources.
result: According to Python’s official queue documentation, queue.Queue lets multiple producer and consumer threads exchange information safely because it provides the required locking internally. That documentation, corroborated by the supplied Python 3.6 documentation excerpt, describes FIFO retrieval and a positive maxsize that blocks insertion when full until items are consumed, helping coordinate producers and consumers. Sources: docs.python.org, getdocs.org, realpython.com.
